leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply CSS Modules to style Angular components with scoped selectors
Configure Angular to process CSS Modules for component-specific styling
Bind CSS class names from modules to component templates
Manipulate component styles using imported CSS Module objects
Integrate CSS Modules with existing Angular component architecture
Construct reusable styling patterns using CSS Modules methodology
Update component styling by modifying CSS Module files
